title: AI‑Native 云计算新纪元：Serverless GPU、Agentic AI 与自研硅片驱动的算力重塑
core_insight: 云计算正加速向 AI‑native、Agentic 与 Serverless GPU 方向重构算力供应链，公有云与区域厂商同步推出自研硅片和本地大模型融合的高密度 AI 实例。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS 在 Lambda 引入 GPU 实例实现 Serverless GPU，Google Cloud 推出 AI 代理服务并通过 AlloyDB Omni 将本地大模型与云端结合，Azure 连续发布面向 agentic AI 的平台组件（Azure Catalyst、Microsoft IQ、Foundry）并提供 Cobalt 200 VM，标志着云原生平台对生成式 AI 与 AI 代理的深度支持。 AWS 将 Amazon S3 Tables 迁移至 Apache Iceberg，提升数据湖治理；Google 发布 Managed Service for Apache Spark 4.0 的 Serverless 引擎并在 GKE 上容器化 AlloyDB；Azure 引入自研硅芯片支持 EDA 工作负载并通过 Azure Failure Prediction 与 Detection 提升可靠性。 AWS Lambda now supports GPU instances for Event Functions on Lambda Managed Instances AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more (November 2, 2026) Amazon S3 Tables now offer managed migration of Apache Hive tables to Apache Iceberg Built for trust and control: Powering the next wave of AI agents across Google Workspace and Google Cloud Data + AI Anywhere: AlloyDB Omni integration with local models Scaling Black Friday pipelines with Managed Airflow agents Microsoft and Oracle bring agentic AI into flow of enterprise work Introducing Azure Catalyst agentic modernization and new AI infrastructure innovations Azure Cobalt 200 VMs now available, proven on real workloads and built for the agentic era
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Azure 通过 Cobalt 200 VM 扩展高性能计算实例，虽未公布新价格，但已在全球多个区域开放；火山引擎正式对外发布全系云产品，标志其在中国公有云市场的区域布局进一步完善。 Cobalt 200 采用自研硅芯片，提升 AI 与 EDA 工作负载的算力密度；Azure 继续深化自研芯片在特定行业（如电子设计自动化）的供给；火山引擎推出 ByteHouse 云数仓，提供大规模并行计算能力。 Azure Cobalt 200 VMs now available, proven on real workloads and built for the agentic era Designing Azure silicon on Azure silicon: EDA workloads on Cobalt 200 Predicting and detecting failures: How Azure strengthens reliability for mission-critical workloads
